test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If L × M means that L is the mother of M, L – M means that L is the father of M, L ÷ M means that L is the sister of M, then which of the following expression shows that P is the father of R?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
L is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 

 
 
to M

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) → Q – P × R ⇒ Q is the father of P who is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/866f3f56fb3a22645bc4250e9abec2a2e0bb8d957db2f79079be580f67dee6f7.png] 

Here, P is the mother of R.

 
• Option - (2) → P – Q ÷ R ⇒ P is the father of Q who is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b76094f6afc7248930a4973d53f46a1964a67bb7c5c316db99ca0b123b45b82.png] 

**Here, P is the father of R.**

 
• Option - (3) → P – Q × R ⇒ P is the father of Q who is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dd025fd9774e43da3a5cd85db3a109fece2acd96b921b2537fdcc7b1cd50aa1.png] 

Here, P is the grand father of R.

 
• Option - (4) → R – P × Q ⇒ R is the father of P who is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89aed11f1372a4b00b890003eebd1e5fc8b1394139be627fb2f39ec374da718c.png] ​

Here, P is the daughter of R.

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
